name: Assembly Hall

text: Cut across the whole width of the wall above the stage:
WHAT IS UNDERSTOOD CAN BE WARNED OF. WHAT IS WARNED OF NEED KILL NOBODY.
It is a good sentence. Somebody meant it.
The lectern, and the card in its holder.
TSUNAMI WARNING: THE FIRST NINE MINUTES. FREE. NO TICKET. ALL WELCOME.
Beside it a jug of water and one glass, filled and not touched.
A display board of nine minutes, drawn as nine panels.
The sea goes out. You run. You do not go back for anything.
The last panel is a hill with people on it and no caption at all.
A board of the villages that have a warning bell and the ones that do not.
The second list used to be longer than the first. It is not any more.
Somebody crosses a name off it about once a month, in front of everyone.
Photographs of full houses. School parties, town councils, fishing crews.
Four hundred seats and a caption saying they are free and always have been.
In every picture, somebody in the front row is taking notes.
A framed page of the hall's rules, and the first of them is the shortest.
ANYONE MAY SPEAK FROM THIS FLOOR.
Under it, the second: AND ANYONE MAY BE ANSWERED FROM IT.
A door at the back of the hall marked STAFF, and beside it the stair
the caretaker uses, going down.
There is nothing on the plan of this building below the assembly hall.
The collection box, and a note on it in the Foundation's usual plain hand:
WE WOULD RATHER YOU CAME BACK THAN GAVE US ANYTHING.
It is very heavy anyway.

_plan: Four hundred free seats, a stage, a straight four-wide aisle from the back stairs (11,16)/(12,16) all the way to the lectern, and nothing in the room that is not honest. It is the Foundation's proudest room, and that is exactly why the confrontation belongs here: Cassian gets to make his case standing in the place his own organisation built for making cases. Set aur_assembly_clear to empty the audience and the speaker in one flag. The stage band y1-y4 is clear full width for actors; the service stair at (2,1)/(3,1) is how somebody arrives from the Deep Survey level without coming through the atrium.
